summary: Battalion Oil Corp filed an 8-K reporting a Preferred Stock Repurchase and Conversion Agreement with Gen IV Investment Opportunities, LLC. The company repurchased 11,716 preferred shares for $19.0 million cash, retiring them, while Gen IV converted remaining preferred shares into 3,494,258 common shares. A concurrent Voting and Lock-Up Agreement binds Gen IV for 12 months to vote with board recommendations. The deal eliminates preferred stock overhang, simplifies capital structure, and reduces future conversion dilution risk. Watch for potential share overhang from converted common stock and any liquidity impact from the cash repurchase.
